description: This file defines the Github OAuth2 provider class, including methods for obtaining authorization URLs, access token URLs, user details URLs, handling responses, and creating user resources within the context of OAuth2 authentication with GitHub.

classes.name: Github
classes.description: A provider class for handling OAuth2 authentication with GitHub, including URL generation, response validation, and user resource creation.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to initiate the OAuth authorization process.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used to retrieve an access token from GitHub.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL to fetch user details from GitHub.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Provides the default OAuth scopes for the provider.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks the API response for errors and throws exceptions if necessary.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates and returns a user resource object based on the response data.
